notes: screens_min 4 = one picture for the statement plate plus one per step with three steps; any shape (screen, phone, book page), shown whole at its own proportion. A tall narrow picture leaves the plate's face empty at its sides.
figures: up to 4 sit in one row at 1440; a value longer than about 8 characters would crowd its cell.
faq needs both q and a; the first question is open, the rest open on press (the reference's lamp is lit on an open one).
Type-led in the sense that no photograph is ever needed, but it is not a page for a client with no product pictures at all.
drops (as written): media.photos and screens that no step names (beyond the one in the statement plate)

made_pictures: none used. The reference has no photograph, backdrop or band anywhere: one flat ground and plates. media.made is not read; the only pictures on the page are the client's own product screens, whole, inside the story's plates.
